text: Madih ayua kuꞌ, ngan ingan jadin nyaꞌa bisayaꞌ tuduꞌ Yesus Kristus, Topaꞌ otoꞌ deꞌ sukup ayuh kuasa-E, idoh diꞌ jok nyeꞌ paguh duoh nyaꞌa deꞌ kaya jaꞌ-a.
Nyam basa ogiꞌ nyaꞌa deꞌ kaya pakai sisin mas duoh pimakai deꞌ sangon, nog takal ingan tikuluk simayang.   Yohmoꞌ takal inoh geh ogiꞌ nyaꞌa deꞌ botak nog, pakai pimakai deꞌ totak lolak,

ingan moꞌ lobih pimodo tuduꞌ nyaꞌa deꞌ paguh pimakai-e inoh, ingan moꞌ sina tuduꞌ-e “Guluꞌ deꞌ klosi deꞌ paguh itih.   ” Pak-e duoh nyaꞌa deꞌ botak inoh, ingan sina tuduꞌ-e, “Mujuag negeh danih” atou “Guluꞌ sinok tubon poꞌon kuꞌ.   ”
Oniꞌ deꞌ nai ingan inoh moꞌ pilih-pilih nyaꞌa.   Ingan moꞌ nilai nyaꞌa nunaꞌ pikil ingan deꞌ jaꞌat.

Madih ayua deꞌ ngibalaꞌ kuꞌ! Topaꞌ pilih nyaꞌa deꞌ nang nyaꞌa botak daang dunia itih odaꞌ jadin ulang deꞌ kaya daang bisayaꞌ-e.   Odop-e deꞌ munoꞌ jadin umat Topaꞌ deꞌ tilimaꞌ bilokat-bilokat soꞌ Topaꞌ deꞌ moꞌ janyi-E tuduꞌ nyaꞌa deꞌ ngibalaꞌ-E.
Pak-e ingan moꞌ pidasaꞌ nyaꞌa deꞌ botak, tiap deꞌ sibonal-e nyaꞌa deꞌ kaya deꞌ adoh-adoh wat-e duoh ingan yohmoꞌ odaꞌ ingan obuah toban keꞌ sulung jowin pingadel ngan-e yaꞌ ngadel ingan.
Ulang kaya deꞌ mutiꞌ leh deꞌ suka nguyat adon Yesus Kristus deꞌ mudi toꞌ.   Yesus Kristus inoh leh deꞌ odaꞌ ingan jadin nyaꞌa deꞌ kakuꞌ Topaꞌ.
Ingan moꞌ nai oniꞌ deꞌ bonal simoꞌ ingan moꞌ nai nunaꞌ atulan deꞌ paling penting-e deꞌ ogiꞌ daang buk Kitab deꞌ in-e, “Ngibalaꞌ leh siodop muꞌ manusia, samah kodaꞌ muꞌu ngibalaꞌ odop muꞌ.   ”
Pak-e simoꞌ ingan jok ingan paguh duoh nyaꞌa deꞌ kaya, ingan moꞌ nai dosa.   Atulan Topaꞌ moꞌ tanon nang ingan moꞌ lawan hukum.
Dop-e simoꞌ nyaꞌa moꞌ nunaꞌ atulan Topaꞌ, pak-e yoh ngilangal niꞌ atulan Topaꞌ, inoh loti-e samah geh duoh yoh ngilangal suaꞌ atulan Topaꞌ.

Dop-e Topaꞌ deꞌ sina nang, “Maꞌ yaꞌ biamai,” Iyoh geh deꞌ nang, “Maꞌ yaꞌ ngabos nyaꞌa.   ” Ngan-e moꞌ wat inoh, moꞌ nyam diꞌ ingan biamai, pak-e ingan ngabos nyaꞌa, ingan tuang moꞌ ngilangal atulan geh.
Suaꞌ oniꞌ deꞌ nang ingan duoh oniꞌ deꞌ nai ingan halus nunaꞌ atulan Topaꞌ, dop-e otoꞌ yaꞌ obuah nguji odaꞌ Topaꞌ pakai atulan inoh.   Atulan inoh leh deꞌ odaꞌ nyaꞌa lopas soꞌ dosa.
Dop-e Topaꞌ diꞌ-e yaꞌ ngin pilasiꞌ tuduꞌ nyaꞌa deꞌ diꞌ-e ngin pilasiꞌ tuduꞌ nyaꞌa deꞌ bokon.   Nyaꞌa deꞌ ngin pilasiꞌ-e diꞌ-e tolu nang odop-e yaꞌ obuah ngukum.
Madih ayua! Doiꞌ guna-e moꞌ nyam-e ogiꞌ nyaꞌa deꞌ ngakuꞌ nang odop-e bisayaꞌ tuduꞌ Kristus, pak-e diꞌ-e nai pingunai deꞌ paguh.   Bisayaꞌ deꞌ wat inoh, diꞌ-e ponai odaꞌ yoh silamat.
Simoꞌ-e ogiꞌ madih nyeꞌ deꞌ samah-samah bisayaꞌ tuduꞌ Topaꞌ, bait deꞌ dali, bait deꞌ dayung, deꞌ pilelu pimakai duoh doiꞌ pinguman-e tibilang konu,

yohmoꞌ ogiꞌ nyaꞌa deꞌ sina nang, “Buu negeh toban kila deꞌ sonang, Topaꞌ ngin bilokat tuduꞌ muꞌu, saꞌ muꞌ dapod man nog muꞌ busuah duoh dapod pakai pimakai deꞌ odaꞌ gonan muꞌ diꞌ-e tiyaꞌ modud.   ” Pak-e nyaꞌa deꞌ sina in inoh tiꞌ-e diꞌ-e ngin oni-oni-e tuduꞌ nyaꞌa deꞌ pilelu man pakai inoh.   Suaꞌ sina deꞌ nang-e inoh doiꞌ guna-e.
Wat inoh geh moꞌ nyam nyaꞌa nang odop-e bisayaꞌ, pak-e pingunai-e diꞌ-e kodaꞌ nyaꞌa deꞌ bisayaꞌ, bisayaꞌ deꞌ wat inoh doiꞌ guna-e.

Pak-e ogiꞌ konik-e nyaꞌa deꞌ nang: “Bisayaꞌ ogiꞌ deꞌ muꞌu, pingunai deꞌ paguh ogiꞌ deꞌ okuꞌ.   ” Yoh ngan kuꞌ yaꞌ nyawot in tih: “Bitanga tuduꞌ okuꞌ kodaꞌ oni bisayaꞌ muꞌ deꞌ diꞌ-e pakai pingunai deꞌ paguh deꞌ nai muꞌ, okuꞌ yaꞌ bitanga bisayaꞌ kuꞌ deꞌ tonga soꞌ pingunai deꞌ paguh deꞌ nai kuꞌ.   ”
Ingan bisayaꞌ nang Topaꞌ jok-e niꞌ, paguh leh! Pak-e gamut-gamut tuang bisayaꞌ geh duoh kimotol tolu.
Ingan manusia deꞌ budua-pilayua, aluaꞌ keh diꞌ ingan ngiloti-e? Bisayaꞌ pak-e diꞌ nyeꞌ nai pingunai deꞌ paguh, doiꞌ loti-e bisayaꞌ deꞌ wat inoh!
Wasn’t Abraham our father justified by works, in that he offered up Isaac his son on the altar?
You see that faith worked with his works, and by works faith was perfected;
and the Scripture was fulfilled which says, “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him as righteousness”; and he was called the friend of God.
You see then that by works, a man is justified, and not only by faith.
In the same way, wasn’t Rahab the prostitute also justified by works, in that she received the messengers, and sent them out another way?
For as the body apart from the spirit is dead, even so faith apart from works is dead.
